task.title: Record a decision as the compliance lead
task.shortdesc: A gap, a stale topic, a missing approval or a conflicting statement can ship with a recorded decision and a reason. A leak can't.

step.cmd: Select Record a decision on a finding, or Record one decision for all for a check.
Choose Release with this recorded or Hold the pack.
Type a reason, then select Save as compliance lead.

info.p: A reason is required. It goes into the manifest with the date.

result.p: When every finding has a decision and none blocks, the status becomes Ready, with recorded decisions.
